ops.title: runtimeQuiesce demands exactness with the freshly recomputed plan — every agent-shape-changing upgrade wedges at quiesce
ops.description:
internal/hookd/deployment.go:473-476 (runtimeQuiesce): the recorded activation plan (from the persisted daemonkit activation receipt at ~/Applications/.daemonkit-deployment/Captain Hook/activation.json) must exactly equal the freshly computed exactServicePlan — digest AND reflect.DeepEqual over the []service.Agent slice. After ANY agent-shape change (12.20.11 dropped LimitLoadToSessionType; the recorded 12.20.9 activation seals the keyed agents), the comparison can never pass again: the recomputed plan describes the NEW shape by definition. Confirmed unaided-unrecoverable on the local machine (2026-07-26, daemonkit investigation 8841b9c0 thread): no bypass exists — package-install rejects args, package-uninstall routes through the same quiesce and dies on the same line. Manual remedy (gated, machine-level): delete activation.json + apply.json (apply.json embeds its own prior copy of the keyed activation), making Prior nil so apply skips quiesce and installs fresh.

Fix shape (per the daemonkit-side analysis): quiesce should stop the RECORDED prior-generation agents — the receipt already names exactly what is running — instead of demanding agreement with a plan the new binary computes. Same wedge class as daemonkit's applyRolledBack gap (fixed v0.20.8) and desired-set recovery fatality (002e2e9a): delivery of a new agent shape gated on agreement with persisted pre-fix state.

ops.text: Quiesce stops the RECORDED prior-generation agents rather than requiring the recorded plan to equal a recomputed one
An upgrade that changes agent shape (field added/removed/value changed) passes quiesce and converges without manual receipt surgery
